provenance: Written for P1b (inc 636) from scratch: every study, number, place and name is fictional. No text from the private G1 or G2 material, from any library, or from any real paper is used.
design_relation_note: design_relation records the author's intent when writing each pair so the workload mixes supporting, contradicting and neutral claims. It is not a scientific label, is not adjudicated, and no acceptance decision reads it.
nli_input_note: The app scores (citation.quote, sentence) pairs: the quote is the premise and the claim sentence the hypothesis (LocalCitationVerifier.verify_many). chunk_text contains the quote verbatim so the quote check passes as it does for a real citation.
